proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13119 sadṛkṣa explicitly supplies Gujarati sarkhũ, Sindhi sarkho and Marathi sārkhā like. Bhilali hərkhā matches the western h- comparative series; Vasavi ṣarko/ṣarkhẽ retain survey retroflex-sibilant notation, aspiration variation and final inflection. Same expresses equivalence. The precise local sound history and cross-Indo-Aryan transmission remain qualified, while the comparative family is supported.
